tasks.title: Digital Marketing: Ad Copy Hook Evaluation
tasks.learningSnippet: A high-converting ad copy hook must grab immediate attention within the first 3 seconds and address a specific pain point rather than making vague promises.
tasks.practicalQuestion: Which of the following ad headlines has the highest click-through conversion rate for Pakistani freelancers?
options: "Make millions without doing any work"
"Struggling to find Upwork clients? Here is how 3 students landed $500 orders this week"
"Click here now for best money secret"
"Freelancing is good"
tasks.explanation: Option 2 targets a real pain point ("struggling to find Upwork clients") with specific proof and relevance.

tasks.title: Customer Service: Handling Refund Inquiries
tasks.learningSnippet: When a client asks for a modification, never respond aggressively. Empathize first, reconfirm the exact scope, and offer a clear revision path.
tasks.practicalQuestion: What is the professional freelance response to an unsatisfied client revision request?
options: "Cancel the order immediately"
"I am sorry the initial draft did not hit the mark. Let me refine section 2 per your notes today"
"It is not my fault, you gave bad instructions"
"Pay extra $50 before I speak with you"
tasks.explanation: Professionalism and proactive resolution protect your 5-star rating on freelance marketplaces.

tasks.title: Cybersecurity: Spotting Phishing & Fake Payment Slips
tasks.learningSnippet: Authentic JazzCash and Easypaisa SMS confirmations always arrive from official sender codes (8558 for JazzCash, 3737 for Easypaisa), never from standard 11-digit personal phone numbers.
tasks.practicalQuestion: You receive an SMS from 0300-1234567 claiming "Rs 5,000 received via JazzCash". Is this legitimate?
options: Yes, it is 100% verified
No, official JazzCash alerts come exclusively from 8558; personal numbers indicate a fake SMS scam
It depends on the time of day
Call the sender and give them your MPIN
tasks.explanation: Official SMS comes only from branded shortcodes (8558 / 3737). Never trust personal number SMS.

tasks.title: Social Media: TikTok Algorithm Watch-Time Optimization
tasks.learningSnippet: TikTok values completion rate and watch loop frequency higher than simple likes. Short, dense 15-second educational videos outperform 3-minute rambling clips.
tasks.practicalQuestion: Which technique best improves video completion rate on TikTok and Instagram Reels?
options: A 10-second silent intro with your logo
Delivering the key takeaway immediately in the first 2 seconds, followed by quick dynamic visual cuts
Asking users to like and subscribe in the first sentence
Using low resolution 480p clips
tasks.explanation: Immediate hook + fast pacing prevents drop-offs and pushes the video to the For You Page (FYP).

tasks.title: Canva Design: High Contrast Social Media Thumbnails
tasks.learningSnippet: Mobile screen users scroll fast. Use complementary contrasting colors (e.g. bold yellow/gold on dark obsidian or deep navy) with maximum 4-6 words on the thumbnail.
tasks.practicalQuestion: Why should YouTube and Reels thumbnails avoid placing text in the bottom right corner?
options: Because YouTube disallows it
Because the video duration badge overlay covers that exact area on mobile screens
Because colors look washed out there
Because it looks too aesthetic
tasks.explanation: The video timestamp badge (e.g. 0:45) is overlaid at the bottom right corner, obscuring any text underneath.

tasks.title: E-Commerce: Winning Product Selection Criteria
tasks.learningSnippet: In Pakistani dropshipping, successful products have a "Wow Factor", solve a real daily pain point, are lightweight (under 1kg to minimize courier TCS/Leopard charges), and have at least 3x markup margin.
tasks.practicalQuestion: Which product fits ideal Pakistani local dropshipping criteria best?
options: A 15kg heavy iron dumbbell with Rs 100 profit margin
A rechargeable mini lint remover solving clothes fuzz with 3x markup and low shipping weight
Counterfeit branded luxury watches with legal risks
Expired liquid cosmetics
tasks.explanation: High perceived value, lightweight delivery, and strong problem-solving attributes minimize return-to-origin (RTO) rates.

tasks.title: Graphic Design: Vector vs Raster for Client Logos
tasks.learningSnippet: Client logos must be created in vector format (.AI, .EPS, .SVG) so they can be infinitely scaled from an app icon to a billboard without pixelation.
tasks.practicalQuestion: A client requests their company logo for a 20-foot outdoor highway billboard. What format should you deliver?
options: A 72 DPI JPEG screenshot from WhatsApp
A vector SVG / EPS / AI file built in Adobe Illustrator or vector software
A Microsoft Word document with pasted image
A low-res GIF
tasks.explanation: Vector graphics are resolution-independent and scale seamlessly to any size without loss of fidelity.

tasks.title: AI Engineering: Few-Shot Prompting Technique
tasks.learningSnippet: Few-shot prompting provides 2 to 3 exemplary input-output pairs inside the prompt before asking the AI model to perform the task. This drastically increases output accuracy and schema adherence.
tasks.practicalQuestion: How does few-shot prompting differ from zero-shot prompting in Gemini and GPT models?
options: Few-shot takes 10 hours to respond
Few-shot provides concrete examples of the desired format inside the prompt, while zero-shot gives no prior examples
Zero-shot uses multiple GPUs while few-shot uses one
Few-shot is only for translation
tasks.explanation: Demonstrations anchor model tone, formatting, and structural constraints with exceptional consistency.

tasks.title: High-Ticket Sales: Discovery Call Qualification Framework
tasks.learningSnippet: Use the BANT framework (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) before spending days preparing customized proposals for international clients.
tasks.practicalQuestion: When an overseas prospect asks for your price on minute 2 of an introductory call, what is the best executive response?
options: "I can do it for $10 please hire me"
"Our custom solutions range based on your exact scale. Let us first spend 5 minutes clarifying your desired revenue goals so I quote accurately"
"Hang up the call immediately"
"Send me $1,000 first"
tasks.explanation: Anchoring price to business objectives and scope prevents commoditization and positions you as an expert consultant.

tasks.title: Agency Scale: Delegation and SOP Documentation
tasks.learningSnippet: To scale a digital agency past $10k/month, founders must transition from working IN the business to ON the business by building Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and hiring junior execution specialists.
tasks.practicalQuestion: What is the primary function of a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) in an agency?
options: To increase office electricity consumption
To provide step-by-step repeatable guidelines ensuring consistent delivery quality independent of who executes it
To impress bank loan officers only
To confuse new interns
tasks.explanation: Clear SOPs allow consistent quality, rapid onboarding, and leverage that enables founders to focus on strategic growth.
